chapterInfo.content:
94
Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔweretɔfoɔ
1 # Deut 32.35 Aweretɔ Nyankopɔn, AWURADE,
aweretɔ Nyankopɔn, pue.
2 # Gye 18.25 Asase temmufoɔ, ma wo ho so,
tua ahokyerɛfoɔ ka.
3AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ,
ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ nni ahurisie?
4Wɔka asɛmdenden,
amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa di ahantansɛm.
5Wo man deɛ, AWURADE, wɔrebɔ no pasaa,
na wɔbrɛ w’agyapadeɛ ase.
6Wɔkum okunafoɔ ne ɔhɔhoɔ,
na wɔdi nwisiaa awu;
7 # Dwom 10.11 na wɔka sɛ: AWURADE renhunu,
na Yakob Nyankopɔn remmu.
8 # Dwom 92.6 Ɔman mu agyimifoɔ, monte aseɛ,
na mo, nkwasea, da bɛn na mobɛhunu de?
9 # Eks 4.11 Deɛ ɔtɛ aso no, ɔrente asɛm,
anaa deɛ ɔnwonoo ani no, ɔrenhunu adeɛ?
10Deɛ ɔtwe amanaman aso no, ɔrentenetene,
deɛ ɔkyerɛ nnipa nimdeɛ no, ɔno ɛ?
11 # 1 Ko 3.20 AWURADE hunu nnipa adwene sɛ ɛyɛ ahuhudeɛ.
12 # Dwom 19.11-13; Hiob 5.17 Nhyira ne onipa a wo, AWURADE, wotwe n’aso,
na wofiri wo mmara no mu kyerɛkyerɛ no,
13 # Dwom 37.7 sɛ wobɛma no nna bɔne ho abodamu
akɔsi sɛ wobɛfunu amena ama ɔbɔnefoɔ.
14Na AWURADE rento ne man ntwene,
na ɔrennya n’agyapadeɛ,
15na atemmuo bɛsane akɔ tenenee mu,
na akoma mu teefoɔ nyinaa bɛdi akyire.
16Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me?
Hwan na ɔbɛgyina ne amumuyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me?
17 # Dwom 115.17 Sɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔyɛ me boafoɔ a,
anka aka kumaa na me kra akɔtena kommyɛ mu.
18Sɛ mese me nan rewatiri a,
wo, AWURADE, w’adɔeɛ na ɛwowa me.
19 # 2 Ko 1.4-5 Me mu dadwene dɔɔso a,
w’awerɛkyekyerɛ gye me kra ani.
20Amammɔeɛ adwa a ɛnam mmara so bɔ mmusuo no
ne wo bɛfa yɔnkoɔ anaa?
21Wɔbɔ ɔteneneeni kra so kyenku,
na wɔbu mogya a ɛdi bem fɔ.
22Nanso AWURADE ayɛ me abankɛseɛ,
na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ me dwanekɔbea botan.
23Na ɔde wɔn mmusuo abua wɔn atifi,
na wɔn bɔne nti ɔbɛyi wɔn hɔ.
AWURADE, aane, yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛyi wɔn hɔ.

Aweretɔ Nyankopɔn, AWURADE,
aweretɔ Nyankopɔn, pue.
Asase temmufoɔ, ma wo ho so,
tua ahokyerɛfoɔ ka.
AWURADE, ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ,
ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na abɔnefoɔ nni ahurisie?
Wɔka asɛmdenden,
amumuyɛfoɔ nyinaa di ahantansɛm.
Wo man deɛ, AWURADE, wɔrebɔ no pasaa,
na wɔbrɛ w’agyapadeɛ ase.
Wɔkum okunafoɔ ne ɔhɔhoɔ,
na wɔdi nwisiaa awu;
na wɔka sɛ: AWURADE renhunu,
na Yakob Nyankopɔn remmu.
Ɔman mu agyimifoɔ, monte aseɛ,
na mo, nkwasea, da bɛn na mobɛhunu de?
Deɛ ɔtɛ aso no, ɔrente asɛm,
anaa deɛ ɔnwonoo ani no, ɔrenhunu adeɛ?
Deɛ ɔtwe amanaman aso no, ɔrentenetene,
deɛ ɔkyerɛ nnipa nimdeɛ no, ɔno ɛ?
AWURADE hunu nnipa adwene sɛ ɛyɛ ahuhudeɛ.
Nhyira ne onipa a wo, AWURADE, wotwe n’aso,
na wofiri wo mmara no mu kyerɛkyerɛ no,
sɛ wobɛma no nna bɔne ho abodamu
akɔsi sɛ wobɛfunu amena ama ɔbɔnefoɔ.
Na AWURADE rento ne man ntwene,
na ɔrennya n’agyapadeɛ,
na atemmuo bɛsane akɔ tenenee mu,
na akoma mu teefoɔ nyinaa bɛdi akyire.
Hwan na ɔbɛsɔre ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me?
Hwan na ɔbɛgyina ne amumuyɛfoɔ adi asie ama me?
Sɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔyɛ me boafoɔ a,
anka aka kumaa na me kra akɔtena kommyɛ mu.
Sɛ mese me nan rewatiri a,
wo, AWURADE, w’adɔeɛ na ɛwowa me.
Me mu dadwene dɔɔso a,
w’awerɛkyekyerɛ gye me kra ani.
Amammɔeɛ adwa a ɛnam mmara so bɔ mmusuo no
ne wo bɛfa yɔnkoɔ anaa?
Wɔbɔ ɔteneneeni kra so kyenku,
na wɔbu mogya a ɛdi bem fɔ.
Nanso AWURADE ayɛ me abankɛseɛ,
na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ me dwanekɔbea botan.
Na ɔde wɔn mmusuo abua wɔn atifi,
na wɔn bɔne nti ɔbɛyi wɔn hɔ.
AWURADE, aane, yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛyi wɔn hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
